capture.reason: Material provider-neutral execution knowledge was derived from the authorized persisted sources.
capture.minimum_next_path: Review and deduplicate only through loki-continuous-improvement.

claim.statement: The proposal-only technical-art pass defined a reuse-first asset contract, preliminary manifest, validation matrix, picture-layer and cleanup constraints, decoded-memory estimates, and asset-to-runtime gates without changing assets or runtime.
The current baseline uses two existing 408 by 560 busts on picture IDs 1 and 2, while Map046 has no parallax and all six tile-data planes are empty.
The POV preferred an exact-resolution parallax-style background and reuse of existing assets, while expression variants and a Cut-In remained conditional for synthesis and approval.

Static asset existence, dimensions, alpha metadata, and decoded-memory estimates do not validate texture residency, preload behavior, scaling, visual composition, performance, frame pacing, or runtime cleanup.
When an empty map already uses low picture IDs for busts, a parallax background can reduce picture-ID migration risk, provided framing, fill, lifetime, and readability are still validated at runtime.

attempt.action: Produce a proposal-only technical-art analysis covering asset viability, dimensions, naming, layering, cleanup, preload, and memory risks.
attempt.outcome: The handoff completed with a validated static contract and passed cross-review, while exact asset delivery and runtime profiling remained gated.

resolution.statement: The pass established a reuse-first, cross-review-ready technical-art contract but intentionally left final naming, asset selection, delivery, and measured runtime behavior unresolved.

cause.statement: The residual uncertainty results from the proposal-only boundary and from properties that require approved final assets, implementation inventory, human Playtest, and profiling on target hardware.

gaps.gap: Reed versus Rheed naming and final creative selections remain human decisions.
Exact approved asset presence, case, dimensions, alpha contract, and checksums remain pending asset intake.
Texture residency, preload, scaling, composition, z-order, readability, performance, frame pacing, branch behavior, and cleanup remain runtime pending.

knowledge.minimum_next_path: Freeze the synthesis-approved manifest and naming, validate delivered assets statically, inventory implementation-time picture ownership, then Playtest and profile both branches at project resolution.
knowledge.reuse_guidance: For comparable technical-art passes, preserve existing filenames and picture IDs, classify new names as provisional, prefer reuse, distinguish calculated texture estimates from measured residency, and pair every asset contract with static intake checks plus runtime profiling gates.
knowledge.avoid_next_time: Do not infer rendering quality, memory safety, plugin-owned cleanup, z-order, or frame pacing from file presence and metadata, and do not migrate picture IDs or rename assets without an explicit approved contract.
